title: ZapMC Network
description: Welcome to ZapMC! A modern network server known for our amazing lifesteal mode! Join us and unlock FREE RANKS, gain hearts by defeating others, and team up with friends. More than just lifesteal/survival is offered!
body:
### Welcome to ZapMC Network!
We're a modern network server that offers offline and crossplay support! Our server is dedicated and known for our amazing lifesteal mode!

Since our launch, we have been dedicated to satisfying players with a custom world with new structures, items, and more to make us unique. We offer free ranks by winning giveaways, events, and more, but they can also be purchased and do not offer any pay-to-win mechanics.

---

## Network Information
### Java Edition
- Network Address: `mc.flibat.com`
- Cracked Port: `25565`
### Bedrock Edition
- Network Address: `mc.flibat.com`
- Bedrock Port: `19132`

ZapMC supports [Simple Voicechat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)! (IS NOT REQUIRED)
